bottom_line: In acute coronary syndromes with a planned invasive strategy, ticagrelor vs clopidogrel reduced the primary composite endpoint (hazard ratio 0.84, 95% CI 0.75–0.94).
implications: Based on the reported 360-day event rates (9.0% vs 10.7%) and hazard ratio (0.84, 95% CI 0.75–0.94), the document supports that ticagrelor was associated with fewer primary composite events than clopidogrel in this planned-invasive-strategy ACS population; based on the reported major bleeding (11.6% vs 11.5%; HR 0.99, 95% CI 0.89–1.10) and GUSTO severe bleeding (3.2% vs 2.9%; HR 0.91, 95% CI 0.74–1.12), it does not support a difference in these bleeding outcomes.

major_points.text: Randomised, double-blind, double-dummy comparison of ticagrelor vs clopidogrel in ACS with a planned invasive strategy.
major_points.quote: In a double-blind, double-dummy study, patients were randomly assigned in a one-to-one ratio to ticagrelor and placebo ... or to clopidogrel and placebo

major_points.text: Population was patients hospitalised for acute coronary syndromes (with or without ST elevation) in whom an invasive strategy was planned at randomisation.
major_points.quote: At randomisation, an invasive strategy was planned for 13 408 (72·0%) of 18 624 patients hospitalised for acute coronary syndromes (with or without ST elevation).

major_points.text: Primary composite endpoint was cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction, or stroke, and analysis was by intention to treat.
major_points.quote: The primary composite endpoint was cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction, or stroke. Analyses were by intention to treat.

major_points.text: Primary composite endpoint occurred less often with ticagrelor than with clopidogrel at 360 days.
major_points.quote: The primary composite endpoint occurred in fewer patients in the ticagrelor group than in the clopidogrel group (569 [event rate at 360 days 9·0%] vs 668 [10·7%], hazard ratio 0·84, 95% CI 0·75–0·94; p=0·0025).

major_points.text: Total major bleeding rates were similar between groups.
major_points.quote: There was no difference between clopidogrel and ticagrelor groups in the rates of total major bleeding (691 [11·6%] vs 689 [11·5%], 0·99 [0·89–1·10]; p=0·8803)

major_points.text: Severe bleeding as defined by GUSTO did not differ between groups.
major_points.quote: or severe bleeding, as defined according to the Global Use of Strategies To Open occluded coronary arteries, (198 [3·2%] vs 185 [2·9%], 0·91 [0·74–1·12]; p=0·3785).

absolute_effects.text: Primary composite endpoint event rate at 360 days: 9.0% vs 10.7%.

harms.text: No difference in total major bleeding between groups was reported.
harms.quote: There was no difference between clopidogrel and ticagrelor groups in the rates of total major bleeding (691 [11·6%] vs 689 [11·5%], 0·99 [0·89–1·10]; p=0·8803)

harms.text: No difference in GUSTO-defined severe bleeding between groups was reported.
harms.quote: severe bleeding, as defined according to the Global Use of Strategies To Open occluded coronary arteries, (198 [3·2%] vs 185 [2·9%], 0·91 [0·74–1·12]; p=0·3785).

analysis_methods.quote: Analyses were by intention to treat.
